templates.title: Aircon Filter Replacement
templates.description: Replace Aircon air filters to maintain air quality and system efficiency
templates.instructions:
1. Turn off Aircon system
2. Locate filter compartment
3. Remove old filter
4. Install new filter with airflow arrow pointing correct direction
5. Turn system back on

templates.title: Smoke Detector Testing
templates.description: Test smoke detectors and replace batteries as needed
templates.instructions:
1. Press test button on each detector
2. Replace batteries if needed
3. Clean dust from detector
4. Verify alarm sounds
templates.regulatoryNotes: Required by fire safety regulations in most jurisdictions

templates.title: Annual Boiler Service
templates.description: Comprehensive annual boiler inspection and servicing
templates.instructions: Professional service required. Technician will inspect all components, clean burners, check safety controls, and test efficiency.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Annual servicing required by gas safety regulations

templates.title: Gutter Cleaning
templates.description: Clean gutters and downspouts to prevent water damage
templates.instructions: Remove debris from gutters, flush downspouts, check for proper drainage and repair any damage.

templates.title: Gas Safety Check (CP12)
templates.description: Annual safety check of every gas appliance, fitting and flue, with a Landlord Gas Safety Record issued
templates.instructions: Book a Gas Safe registered engineer. Check every gas appliance, pipework and flue. Keep the Landlord Gas Safety Record (CP12) and give tenants a copy.
checklistItems: Give tenant a copy within 28 days
templates.regulatoryNotes: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998: annual check by a Gas Safe registered engineer; tenants must receive a copy of the record within 28 days.

templates.title: Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR)
templates.description: Inspection and test of the fixed electrical installation by a qualified electrician
templates.instructions: Book a qualified, registered electrician. Complete any remedial work flagged C1, C2 or FI within 28 days and get written confirmation.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Electrical Safety Standards in the Private Rented Sector (England) Regulations 2020: inspect at least every 5 years; tenants receive a copy within 28 days.
templates.source: Electrical Safety Standards in the Private Rented Sector (England) Regulations 2020

templates.title: Carbon Monoxide Alarm Test
templates.description: Test carbon monoxide alarms in rooms with a fixed combustion appliance
templates.instructions:
1. Press and hold the test button on each CO alarm
2. Replace batteries or the unit if it fails or is past its expiry date
3. Record the test date
checklistItems: Replace batteries or unit if needed
templates.regulatoryNotes: Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm (Amendment) Regulations 2022: a CO alarm is required in any room with a fixed combustion appliance (excluding gas cookers), checked on the first day of each new tenancy.
templates.source: Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm (Amendment) Regulations 2022

templates.title: Legionella Risk Assessment Review
templates.description: Review the legionella risk assessment for the hot and cold water system
templates.instructions: Check for stored or stagnant water, tank condition and hot water temperatures (stored at 60°C). Review sooner after changes to the system or a long void period.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and HSE ACOP L8: landlords must assess and control the risk of legionella. A two-yearly review is common practice, not a fixed legal interval.

templates.title: Boiler Pressure Check & Radiator Bleed
templates.description: Check boiler pressure and bleed radiators before the heating season
templates.instructions:
1. With the heating off and cool, bleed each radiator until water runs
2. Check the boiler pressure gauge (usually 1–1.5 bar cold)
3. Top up via the filling loop if low
4. Turn heating on and check radiators heat evenly

templates.title: Heat Pump Annual Service
templates.description: Annual service of an air or ground source heat pump
templates.instructions: Book an MCS-certified installer or manufacturer-approved engineer. Check refrigerant, filters, outdoor unit airflow, controls and system pressure.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Annual servicing is usually a condition of the manufacturer warranty.

templates.title: Storage Heater Check
templates.description: Check electric storage heaters and controls before winter
templates.instructions: Check each heater charges overnight and releases heat, the input and output controls work, vents are clear and the casing is undamaged.

templates.title: Roof & Chimney Inspection
templates.description: Visual inspection of the roof, flashing and chimney for damage or leaks
templates.instructions: Check for slipped or missing tiles, damaged flashing, chimney pointing and signs of water getting in, ideally in autumn.
checklistItems: Check loft for signs of leaks

templates.title: Drains & Downpipes Check
templates.description: Check drains, gullies and downpipes are clear and flowing
templates.instructions: Clear leaves from gullies, run water through each downpipe and check drains flow freely without smells or standing water.
checklistItems: Note any smells or slow drainage

templates.title: Damp & Mould Inspection
templates.description: Inspect for damp, condensation and mould, and fix the cause
templates.instructions: Check walls, ceilings, window frames and behind furniture, especially bathrooms, kitchens and north-facing rooms. Identify the cause (leak, rising damp, condensation) rather than just treating the mould.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Homes (Fitness for Human Habitation) Act 2018 and HHSRS: damp and mould are hazards landlords must deal with promptly.

templates.title: Extractor Fans & Ventilation Check
templates.description: Check extractor fans, trickle vents and air bricks work and are clear
templates.instructions: Run each kitchen and bathroom extractor fan and check it pulls air, clean the grille, open trickle vents and check air bricks are unblocked.

templates.title: Portable Appliance Testing (PAT)
templates.description: Safety test electrical appliances supplied with the property
templates.instructions: Have a competent person test each appliance you supply (kettle, microwave, washing machine, etc.) and label it with the test date.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Not a legal requirement for single-household lets in England, but recommended for appliances you supply and expected for HMOs.

templates.title: Locks, Doors & Windows Check
templates.description: Check external doors, locks and window catches work and are secure
templates.instructions: Check each external door closes and locks, window locks and restrictors work, and keys are accounted for. Consider changing locks between tenancies.

templates.title: Periodic Property Inspection
templates.description: Routine inspection during the tenancy to spot repairs early
templates.instructions: Give the tenant at least 24 hours' written notice. Walk each room, note repairs needed and photograph condition.
templates.regulatoryNotes: Landlords must give at least 24 hours' written notice before entering (Landlord and Tenant Act 1985, s.11(6)).
